name: codebase
description: scan every chunk of the tracked source, then synthesise, attack, and plan

tiers.name: scan
tiers.task: Enumerate every public symbol and every checkable claim in the docstrings and comments above, and give each claim a verdict against THIS code. Report what you observe, not what you suspect about code you cannot see. If a claim refers to something outside this chunk, its verdict is 'uncheckable'.

tiers.name: research
tiers.intro: You have {inputs} independent scan reports from different parts of one Python codebase (the Daedalus agent harness: an agent orchestration kernel with budget, egress and evaluation subsystems).
tiers.task: Find what spans them. State each cross-file pattern as a hypothesis with a refutation condition.

tiers.name: review
tiers.intro: You have {inputs} hypotheses produced by a research tier over the Daedalus codebase. Attack each one.
tiers.task: For each: the strongest counterargument first, then whether it survives, then the narrowest surviving form, then the concrete check that would settle it. Default to refuted when uncertain.

tiers.name: plan
tiers.intro: You have {inputs} reviewed findings about the Daedalus codebase. The reviewer already discarded what it refuted; these survived.
tiers.task: Turn the survivors into ordered work. Every step names a file and the check that proves it worked.
